sources.name: alphaXiv
sources.purpose: Popular research discovery and optional native researcher/library management.

auth.instructions: Use the external harness native alphaXiv MCP connection. The host owns OAuth and account selection; this descriptor is not authorization.

agent.instructions: Use the host native alphaXiv connection. Discover its currently exposed tool descriptions and input schemas before choosing or calling a tool. Operation tool names below are hints, not guarantees of present availability. The host owns authentication and permissions. Read the saved source requirements and context; prepare complete reading content through the shared recommendation submission entry. Account writes require the actual requested scope and are recorded separately from proposals.

operations.description: Read the source-ordered popular research feed. Resolve returned universal IDs to verified papers, projects or Blogs before recommendation.
operations.inputs: Use the current native tool schema for supported feed conditions; do not invent pagination.
operations.outputs: A bounded source-ordered feed of universal IDs and any metadata actually returned.

operations.description: Read the connected account personalized research feed when the requested scope calls for it.
operations.inputs: The selected host-authorized account and arguments supported by the current tool schema.
operations.outputs: Personalized feed entries, retaining actual identity and ordering from the source.

operations.description: Retrieve paper content in its actual reported mode. AI intermediate reports are not author abstracts; request raw extraction only through supported arguments.
operations.inputs: A verified paper identity and current native arguments, including fullText only when supported and requested.
operations.outputs: An AI intermediate report or extracted text, with its actual scope preserved.

operations.description: Obtain relevant paper passages for a selected question without presenting a partial answer as a complete source reading.
operations.inputs: A verified paper identity and the selected questions under the current tool schema.
operations.outputs: Relevant returned passages or answers, retaining available source locations and limitations.

operations.description: Find researchers relevant to selected topics using only actually exposed native capabilities.
operations.inputs: The selected topic or researcher identity, mapped to a discovered native tool schema.
operations.outputs: Researcher candidates and evidence links; a suggestion does not follow an account.

operations.description: Apply an explicitly authorized researcher follow change through a supported native account operation.
operations.inputs: An unambiguous researcher identity and the requested follow change, using the current native schema and host authorization.
operations.outputs: The actual reported remote result or uncertainty; record it through source operation history without blind retries.

operations.description: Manage the native alphaXiv reading library within the explicit user request; do not create a second local library authority.
operations.inputs: The selected native item and requested library operation, checked against currently available tools and permissions.
operations.outputs: The actual native result and public evidence when available, recorded as agent-reported rather than verified cloud truth.

sources.name: Hugging Face Daily Papers
sources.purpose: Community-discovered papers and their source observations.

interfaces.instructions: Use the existing configured recommend-papers aggregator with hf_daily enabled; its candidate output still needs the shared submission envelope.

auth.instructions: The existing public adapter uses the operator configured proxy route. Availability is checked on actual retrieval.

agent.instructions: Read the public Hugging Face Daily Papers API with the host HTTP tool or use the existing installed recommend-papers aggregator with hf_daily enabled. Check current API or CLI documentation before selecting arguments. The aggregator returns source candidates, not the shared recommendation submission envelope; obtain complete authoritative abstracts and translate them before submission. Preserve the configured provider network route. Daily Papers upvotes are distinct from model likes and repository stars.

operations.description: Read public daily-paper metadata and observed community upvotes.
operations.inputs: A bounded requested result count and any conditions supported by the current API or configured aggregator.
operations.outputs: Paper identities, titles, authors, original summaries and community upvotes when provided; no invented counts or automatic ingestion.

sources.name: X — own-account curated posts
sources.purpose: Future collection of only the selected own account reposts or bookmarks.

auth.instructions: Future integration must use only the user selected own account and an explicit cost boundary. No other accounts or home timeline collection.

sources.name: Zhihu — own-account collections
sources.purpose: Future collection of only the selected own account collection or collection folder.

interfaces.instructions: Future thin integration may use the official Zhihu CLI for the selected own account collection.

auth.instructions: Future native credential setup belongs to the official tool. This catalog does not read accounts, private collections or credentials.
